What I searched:

- Searched path: .../project/docs and .../project/docs/suppliers (all supplier .docx files).
- I opened sample supplier agreements: supplier-agreement-acme.docx (Clause 6: "Pricing. Unit prices are subject to an indexed price cap..."), supplier-agreement-borealis.docx (Clause 6 similar), supplier-agreement-corvid.docx (Clause 6 similar), supplier-agreement-dunmore.docx (Clause 6: "Unit prices are fixed for the term..."), and ran grep across supplier-agreement-005..120 and named supplier files.

No supplier agreement in the documents contains a most-favoured-nation / MFN pricing clause based on those searches.
